About
The University of South Florida's new Medical Engineering Department is an interdisciplinary
bridge between the College of Engineering and the Morsani College of Medicine, which
partners with Moffitt Cancer Center, Tampa General Hospital, and other biomedical
institutions in the Tampa Bay area.
Its unique structure facilitates research and academic interactions between engineers,
scientists and clinicians to pursue medical discoveries, translational technologies,
and didactic learning experiences through MS and PhD programs in Biomedical
Engineering.
Research efforts of department and affiliate faculty are concentrated in:
Biomechanics
Biomedical Imaging and Bioelectronics
Cell and Tissue Engineering
Molecular Medicine and Drug Delivery
Neural and Rehabilitation Engineering
Graduate Recruiting Info Session
Choosing a biomedical engineering graduate program became easier after learning about
USF Medical Engineering. Attendees have the opportunity to speak with our professors
about their research and ask questions. If you miss it, you can still catch up by
watching the recording.
Upcoming information session is on October 30th 3 – 4:30 pm.
Message from the Department Chair & Graduate Advisor
Welcome to the University of South Florida Biomedical Engineering (BME) Graduate Program.
I am Dr. Robert Frisina, Chair of the Medical Engineering Department and Graduate
Program Director. I look forward to meeting with you to plan your courses each semester,
and can assist you in choosing a research advisor and committee for PhD students and
those pursuing a master's degree with thesis.
Communicating with me each semester is important to optimize your academic and course
plans, and for meeting college and graduate program requirements. There are important
links in the side navigation bar which you should familiarize yourself with for your
program.
You are entering a great new phase of your career here in Tampa. Do not hesitate to
contact me with any questions or concerns that you have. Our Academic Program Specialist, Ms. Skyler Cruz, is also a great resource for navigating through the milestones of your program in
the administrative structure here at the University of South Florida College of Engineering
and Graduate School.
